context: Evaluates correct implementation of the offer management API from visionarias-client. Tests cover the TypeScript enum definitions for the offer domain model, correct HTTP methods for each operation, Bearer token authentication, and proper use of PATCH for partial updates.

checklist.name: OfferStatus enum
checklist.description: OfferStatus enum is defined with all 6 values: DRAFT, ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, WAITLIST, SOLD_OUT

checklist.name: OfferValueLevel enum
checklist.description: OfferValueLevel enum is defined with values N0 through N6 representing the 7 offer ladder positions

checklist.name: OfferDeliveryModel enum
checklist.description: OfferDeliveryModel enum is defined with values DIY, DWY, DFY, B2B

checklist.name: GET for getOffer
checklist.description: getOffer sends a GET request to /api/offers/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token>

checklist.name: POST for createOffer
checklist.description: createOffer sends a POST request to /api/offers with Authorization: Bearer <token>

checklist.name: PATCH for saveOffer
checklist.description: saveOffer sends a PATCH request (not PUT) to /api/offers/{id} with JSON body containing only the provided partial data

checklist.name: DELETE for deleteOffer
checklist.description: deleteOffer sends a DELETE request to /api/offers/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token>
